name: Comoros (1978–1992)
description: A green field with a white crescent, its horns pointing down towards the lower fly, enclosing four white five-pointed stars in a diagonal row.
history: Flag of the Federal Islamic Republic of the Comoros adopted on 1 October 1978 after Ahmed Abdallah's return to power, restoring the green of the 1963 flag with the crescent and four stars now grouped together. The 1992 constitution rotated the crescent to open upward, giving the flag used from 7 June 1992.
